description: yzj-flow 机械兜底：上下文压缩后自动重注入红线与本需求恢复卡；git commit 前检查 AI 记号（拒绝）与主干直提（弹窗确认，单次授权）。脚本随技能源分发，fail-open。

hooks.command: for p in python3 python py; do "$p" -c "import sys" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/dev-session/scripts/restore_context.py"; done; exit 0
for p in python3 python py; do "$p" -c "import sys" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/git-commit/scripts/commit_guard.py" pretooluse; done; exit 0
